items.title: Updated Apple Developer Program License Agreement now available
items.summary: The Apple Developer Program License Agreement has been revised to support new features and updated policies, and to provide clarification. Please review the changes below and sign in to your account to accept the updated terms. Section 3.2: Updated security and related requirements for using Apple’s software and services.Definitions, Section 3.3.8(j):  Specified terms for use of the Live Assistance API.Definitions, Section 3.3.8(k): Specified terms for use of the App Replacement Entitlement.Definitions, Definitions, Sections 6.4, 6.4.1, 6.4.2: Specified terms for iOS app widgets on Apple HomeView and availability of iOS apps for CarPlay on Apple HomeView.Schedule 2, Sections 1.1(b), 1.2(d)(iv), 3.1, 3.8(c): Specified terms for offering multiple seats for a subscription through Group Purchases.Schedule 3, Sections 1.1(b), 1.2(d)(iii), 3.1, 3.8(a), 3.8(c): Specified terms for offering subscriptions to Apple Business and Apple School Manager organizations through Volume Purchasing.Schedule 2, Section 3.3(a); Schedule 3, Section 3.3(a): Specifies that Apple will report legally required information such as tax, sales, and contact details to tax authorities.Schedule 2, Section 3.3(b); Schedule 3, Section 3.3(b): Restricts the use of any customer tax information shared by Apple with developers to only those purposes mandated by law.Translations of the updated agreement will be available on the Apple Developer website within one month.
